title: Cache Line Refill FSM
constraints: Lines are 4 words. The word address is `{line, beat}` (line × 4 + beat).
IDLE: a rising edge sampling `miss = 1` latches `miss_line`, `victim_line` and `dirty`. It goes to **WRITEBACK** if dirty, else straight to **REFILL**, starting at beat 0.
WRITEBACK: `mem_req = 1`, `mem_we = 1`, `mem_addr = {victim_line, beat}`. Each edge with `mem_ack = 1` completes a beat. After beat 3 it goes to REFILL, beat 0.
REFILL: `mem_req = 1`, `mem_we = 0`, `mem_addr = {miss_line, beat}`. After beat 3 is acknowledged: one cycle of `done = 1`, then IDLE.
Moore outputs. `mem_we` / `mem_addr` are don't-care when `mem_req = 0`. `miss` is ignored unless IDLE. Synchronous reset → IDLE. Must be synthesizable.
hints: States: IDLE, WB, RF, DONE, plus a 2-bit beat counter.
Memory may take several cycles per beat. Only advance the beat on edges where `mem_ack` is 1.
Latch the addresses at the start: the cache may change its inputs while the refill runs.

examples.title: clean victim
examples.input: miss with dirty = 0, memory acks every cycle
examples.expected: 4 refill beats (addresses line*4 … line*4+3), then done

examples.title: dirty victim
examples.expected: 4 write-back beats to the victim, then 4 refill beats, then done

examples.title: wait states
examples.expected: each beat holds its address until acknowledged
